name: Light Fades Twice Lizalfos + Chilfos PRIVATE TEST
author: Dusklight community mods
description: 0.13.4 CHILFOS FIX04 over Lizalfos FIX05 0.12.5 (Lizalfos unchanged). The Chilfos (E_KK) fights with four learnable combos (one ends with a backstep, a real spear throw and a fast restore); its C3 throw wind-up no longer casts a giant collision line every frame; one clash, one spark and one result per spear attack; blocks and parries always get their spark; it keeps facing Link while it waits and raises its guard when it decides to cover a swing; fast double thrusts at x1.10; its spear never breaks when it blocks or parries; it parries and counters. HP and posture are two independent ways to win: HP 0 kills it normally, hidden skills deal ordinary damage, and at 100 posture it staggers for 3 s: a new sword hit, Shield Attack then Helm Splitter, or B for Link's native Mortal Draw finishes it. HUMAN_RUNTIME_PENDING. Replace only this ID; rollback 0.13.3.
